acts.title: The 1763 Turning Point
acts.purpose: Understand Britain's victory creates enormous debt and two conflicting ledgers for the empire.

acts.title: The End of Salutary Neglect
acts.purpose: Understand Grenville ends beneficial neglect to enforce trade laws and collect revenue.

acts.title: Drawing the Line
acts.purpose: Understand the Proclamation Line was triage to avoid another expensive frontier war, not punishment.

acts.title: A Fence That Failed
acts.purpose: Understand the line failed as a fence, stung as an insult, and set a pattern for Indian country.

acts.title: Why Pontiac Fought
acts.purpose: Understand French gift diplomacy versus Amherst's cuts and Neolin's prophetic vision behind the revolt.

acts.title: The Frontier Burns Both Ways
acts.purpose: Understand fort seizures, smallpox blankets, Paxton Boys, and who the 1763 rebels actually were.

acts.title: Landing the Three Boxes
acts.purpose: Recap all three boxes and apply the Proclamation to an AP stimulus about cheap triage.

acts.title: Broken Trust and Next Taxes
acts.purpose: Understand broken trust as the war's deepest effect and preview the coming tax fights.
